text:
Marta: FYI I opened a docs PR to tighten up the private installer cert-chain guidance for air-gapped and VPC installs. Needs quick reviews for cert rotation, file perms, and PKCS#11 notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6120

Alex: grabbing a look now. One quick thing: should we explicitly mention differences between /etc/ssl/certs and /opt/redwood/certs for RPM vs DEB installs? Some customers keep CA bundles in nonstandard locations.

Marta: yep, I added a small section. Recommended pattern: place runtime certs under /opt/redwood/certs and add a systemd drop-in so the service picks up SSL_CERT_DIR. Also called out update-ca-certificates for Debian.

Sam: can you paste the systemd override you added so I can sanity-check for conflicts with other unit overrides?

Marta: pasted below:

```
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood.service.d/override.conf
[Service]
Environment=SSL_CERT_DIR=/opt/redwood/certs
Restart=on-failure
```

Sam: looks good. Add a note about ordering with tmpfiles.d and that `systemctl daemon-reload` is required after deploying the drop-in.

Li: security note 014 we should not recommend world-readable locations for private certs or keys. Recommend 750 on /opt/redwood/certs and chown to redwood:redwood. Also call out that for PKCS#11 modules the installer should use absolute library paths (avoid ldconfig-only lookups).

Marta: added permission snippet and explicit PKCS#11 guidance. Also added a short example for setting SELinux file contexts on RHEL9.

Alex: the vendor PKCS#11 link in the PR 404s currently (was https://vendor.example.com/pkcs11-guide). Can you point to the exact ABI doc path?

Marta: updated to an internal redirect: https://docs.redwood.com/vendor/hsm/pkcs11-abi and put fallback text: "If this link is inaccessible, contact your HSM vendor or sales engineer for the module path and ABI doc."

deploy-bot: docs build started for PR #6120 014 lint/link-check

deploy-bot: link-check: 1 failure (https://docs.redwood.com/vendor/hsm/pkcs11-abi) at docs/priv-vpc/install.md: line 312

Marta: weird, the redirect failed in the link-checker. I updated to include the canonical vendor URL plus the internal proxy and added a text fallback to avoid build breaks.

Sam: sometimes vendor sites block our UA; including both the canonical vendor URL and the docs.redwood proxy should make the doc resilient.

Marta: pushed update.

deploy-bot: docs build started for PR #6120 014 lint/link-check

deploy-bot: all checks passed \u2705

Jen: can we include a short migration section for customers moving from v1 installer to v2? We had a support ticket where certs lived in /etc/ssl and the KMS module path was relative.

Marta: added a migration checklist: 
1) copy certs from /etc/ssl/certs to /opt/redwood/certs
2) `sudo chown -R redwood:redwood /opt/redwood/certs && sudo chmod -R 750 /opt/redwood/certs`
3) update installer config: set `kms.pkcs11.module_path` to the absolute vendor .so path
4) `systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart redwood`

Alex: can we add a simple sanity-check command after install, e.g.:

```
# verify TLS from service account and that certs are loadable
sudo -u redwood curl --cacert /opt/redwood/certs/root.pem https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz
```

Marta: added that and a note about SELinux booleans and common Debian quirks (`update-ca-certificates --fresh`).

Li: security ack pending wording change: replace "avoid placing certs in world-readable directories" with stronger phrasing.

Marta: updated wording to: "Do not place private keys or customer secrets in world-readable locations. Use 750 perms and limit group membership."

Sam: another docs nit014 the Kubernetes tenant example references a `redwood.certs` secret but we didn't show how to mount it as a directory. Can you add a minimal k8s secret+mount example for on-prem clusters?

Marta: added a concise snippet:

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: redwood-certs
type: Opaque
stringData:
  root.pem: |-
    -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n    ...\n    -----END CERTIFICATE-----
---
# mount example within a pod spec
volumeMounts:
- name: certs
  mountPath: /opt/redwood/certs
volumes:
- name: certs
  secret:
    secretName: redwood-certs
```

Alex: great. Last ask: add a one-line troubleshooting FAQ: "If healthcheck fails with TLS errors, verify cert chain order, file permissions, and PKCS#11 module path."

Marta: done. I also added a short checklist (perm, SELinux, module path, restart) and noted the cherry-pick plan to v1-maintenance branch. Merging once CI green; will send a heads-up to solutions-eng channel after cherry-pick.

Sam: approving from infra. :thumbsup:

Li: security ack. :white_check_mark:

Alex: minor typo fixed inline; LGTM.

Marta: merged and cherry-pick scheduled. Thanks all! :heart:
